findings.summary: Owned SDK initialization leaks malformed resource environment values through OTel global diagnostics before safe exporters.
findings.reproduction: Fresh process; OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=PRIVATE_SENTINEL_MALFORMED_RESOURCE; call metry.New(ctx,WithServiceName("zl-mcp")) exactly as newOwned. Both resource Detect and Default report the raw sentinel on stderr. Invalid percent resource encoding also reaches SDK diagnostics.
findings.required_fix: Neutral host validation before SDK resource initialization, or compatible pinned public API that supplies a safe explicit resource; no process-global error-handler mutation or sibling library edit. Add fresh-process malformed environment sentinel tests.

findings.summary: Moving the operational call audit into app execution drops rejected preflights and misreports later response failures.
findings.reproduction: Bind/admission/BindArguments/input.Validate errors return before Observer.Execute. Projection/encode/response-budget errors occur after its audit has already reported app success. The former deferred Service.call audit captured the final MCP response and its safe domain error code.
findings.required_fix: Retain one safe final-call diagnostic for rejected preflight and post-execution response failures, without duplicating ExecutorWrap/application spans. Preserve bounded operational error codes and privacy. Cover denied principal, rate limit, invalid arguments and post-execution response-budget failures.
